note: The Sunken Crypt dungeon now hides hand-crafted vault rooms: treasure hoards, monster dens, shrines, a lava forge, a bone crypt and more, tucked into every level. Walk into one and the game names it — its gold-ringed rooms hold real monsters and real loot. Also fixed: a slain monster no longer blocks the tile it died on, so a killed guardian can no longer seal a corridor behind it
